items.title: 人称代词主格与宾格的选用
items.brief: 格由句法位置决定：主语用主格，动词介词后用宾格

concept.summary: 人称代词的格由它在句中的功能决定：作主语用主格，作及物动词或介词的宾语用宾格。并列结构中每个代词各自按位置取格，than/as 后的代词按补全后的成分定。口语中作表语可用宾格，正式书面语用主格。

sections.p: 先找代词在句中充当什么成分，再选形式。主语、主语同位语用主格；动词宾语、介词宾语、宾语同位语用宾格。不要用汉语的「我」一个字形直接对应两种英语形式。
bullets: 主格：I, you, he, she, it, we, they
宾格：me, you, him, her, it, us, them
介词后一律宾格：between you and me, for him, with us
主语同位语也用主格：We students should take notes.

sections.p: 并列主语用主格，并列宾语用宾格；顺序上单数并列通常第二、第三人称在前（you, he and I），承担责任或自我批评时 I 前置。
bullets: My brother and I went fishing.（并列主语）
The teacher praised Tom and me.（并列宾语）
You, he and I will share the task.（231 顺序）
I and my brother broke the window.（主动承担责任，I 前置）

sections.p: than/as 后的代词按补全省略后的成分定：省略的是谓语部分的主语，用主格；省略的是宾语，用宾格。系动词后作表语，正式书面语用主格。
bullets: She is taller than I (am).（省略 am，用主格）
She likes him more than (she likes) me.（省略宾语，用宾格）
It was she who first noticed the error.（正式表语用主格）

examples.en: My brother and I went fishing last weekend.
examples.zh: 上周末我和弟弟去钓鱼了。
examples.note: 并列成分作主语，用主格 I，且 I 置于最后。

examples.en: My brother and me went fishing last weekend.
examples.zh: 上周末我和弟弟去钓鱼了。
examples.note: 主语位置必须用主格，me 是宾格形式。

examples.en: Between you and me, the plan will not work.
examples.zh: 咱们私下说，这个计划行不通。
examples.note: between 是介词，其后用宾格 me。

examples.en: Between you and I, the plan will not work.
examples.zh: 咱们私下说，这个计划行不通。
examples.note: 介词后须用宾格，应为 between you and me。

examples.en: The teacher gave the certificates to Tom and me.
examples.zh: 老师把证书发给了汤姆和我。
examples.note: 介词 to 的并列宾语用宾格。

examples.en: The teacher gave the certificates to Tom and I.
examples.zh: 老师把证书发给了汤姆和我。
examples.note: 介词 to 后不能用主格 I。

examples.en: She is much taller than I am.
examples.zh: 她比我高得多。
examples.note: than 后补全谓语 am，主语用主格 I。

pitfalls.wrong: Me and my sister share a room.
pitfalls.right: My sister and I share a room.
pitfalls.why: 主语位置必须用主格，且并列时 I 通常置于最后。

pitfalls.wrong: This is a secret between you and I.
pitfalls.right: This is a secret between you and me.
pitfalls.why: between 是介词，其后必须用宾格。

pitfalls.wrong: Us students should study hard.
pitfalls.right: We students should study hard.
pitfalls.why: 同位语说明主语，格随主语，须用主格 we。

contrast.withTitle: 形容词性与名词性物主代词
contrast.diff: 主格宾格解决「作主语还是作宾语」；物主代词解决「谁的」，两套形式不能互换。

concept.mnemonic: 动词介词后面用宾格，主语位置用主格；并列先人后我，认错时我先说。

core: 主语、主语同位语：主格（I, he, we, they）
动词宾语、介词宾语、宾语同位语：宾格（me, him, us, them）
并列主语用主格，并列宾语用宾格
单数并列顺序 you, he and I；承担责任时 I 前置
than/as 后按补全的成分定：than I (am) / than me
review.trigger: 看到代词 → 先确定它是主语还是宾语 → 主语取主格，介词或动词后取宾格

quickCheck.q: between you and ___ 填什么？
My friend and I 还是 My friend and me？
quickCheck.a: My friend and I，作主语用主格。

quickCheck.q: She is taller than I am. 中为什么用 I？
quickCheck.a: than 后补全省略的 am，I 作主语。

drills.stem: Last summer, my cousin and ___ spent two weeks hiking in Yunnan.
drills.explain: 并列成分在句中作主语，须用主格 I；my 与 mine 是物主代词，不能充当主语。
drills.trap: me 是宾格，受汉语「我和表哥」的语序影响最易误选。

drills.stem: Between you and ___, this plan is unlikely to work. (I)
drills.explain: 介词 between 后接宾格，故用 me。

drills.stem: Me and my classmates are preparing a poster for the science fair.
drills.answer: My classmates and I are preparing a poster for the science fair.
accept: My classmates and I are preparing a poster for the science fair.
drills.explain: 主语位置用主格 I，且并列时 I 置于最后。

drills.stem: The award was presented to ___ at the ceremony.
drills.explain: 介词 to 后接并列宾语，两个代词都用宾格。
drills.trap: he and I 是主格组合，只在作主语时成立。

drills.stem: 我和我的父母上周末去了博物馆。
drills.answer: My parents and I went to the museum last weekend.
drills.explain: 并列主语用主格 I 并置于最后；forbid 中两种写法分别犯了宾格作主语与语序不当的错误。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: She invited my sister and me to the party.
drills.explain: invited 的并列宾语用宾格 me；to the party 是地点状语。

items.title: 形容词性与名词性物主代词
items.brief: 后面有名词用 my，独立使用用 mine

concept.summary: 物主代词分两套：形容词性（my, your, his, her, its, our, their）必须后接名词，名词性（mine, yours, his, hers, its, ours, theirs）独立充当主语、宾语或表语。判断只看后面有没有名词：有名词用形容词性，没有名词用名词性。

sections.p: 除 his 与 its 两套同形外，其余都有独立形式。名词性物主代词等于「形容词性 + 名词」，因此后面不能再出现名词。
bullets: my → mine；your → yours；her → hers；our → ours；their → theirs
his → his；its → its（同形，名词性形式极少用）
× mine book / × my；√ my book / √ mine

sections.p: 形容词性只作定语；名词性可作主语、宾语、表语，还可与 of 构成双重所有格。
bullets: 主语：Mine is the blue one.
宾语：You can use mine.
表语：The decision is theirs.
双重所有格：a friend of mine / a colleague of hers

sections.p: 形容词性物主代词本身是限定词，不能与 a/an/the/this 并用；需要 all/both 时放在物主代词之前。要表达「我的一个」时改用双重所有格。
bullets: × a my friend；√ a friend of mine
× this my book；√ this book of mine
× my all friends；√ all my friends

examples.en: This is my laptop and that one is yours.
examples.zh: 这是我的笔记本电脑，那台是你的。
examples.note: my 后接名词，yours 独立作表语。

examples.en: This is my laptop and that one is your.
examples.zh: 这是我的笔记本电脑，那台是你的。
examples.note: your 必须后接名词，独立使用应为 yours。

examples.en: Her explanation was clearer than his.
examples.zh: 她的解释比他的更清楚。
examples.note: his 在此是名词性物主代词，等于 his explanation。

examples.en: Her explanation was clearer than him.
examples.zh: 她的解释比他的更清楚。
examples.note: 比较对象是 his explanation，用名词性物主代词 his；him 指人，比较对象不对应。

examples.en: A colleague of mine recommended the book.
examples.zh: 我的一位同事推荐了这本书。
examples.note: 双重所有格由 of + 名词性物主代词构成。

examples.en: A colleague of me recommended the book.
examples.zh: 我的一位同事推荐了这本书。
examples.note: 双重所有格须用名词性物主代词，of me 结构不成立。

examples.en: All my friends came to the party.
examples.zh: 我所有的朋友都来参加聚会了。
examples.note: all 置于形容词性物主代词之前。

pitfalls.wrong: This book is my.
pitfalls.right: This book is mine.
pitfalls.why: 表语位置没有名词可修饰，必须用名词性物主代词。

pitfalls.wrong: He is a friend of my.
pitfalls.right: He is a friend of mine.
pitfalls.why: of 后接名词性物主代词构成双重所有格。

pitfalls.wrong: My all friends came to the party.
pitfalls.right: All my friends came to the party.
pitfalls.why: all 是前位限定词，须放在物主代词之前。

contrast.withTitle: 人称代词主格与宾格的选用
contrast.diff: 物主代词表所属关系（谁的），不随主宾位置变化；主格宾格表句法功能，同一人称有两种形式。

concept.mnemonic: 后面有名词用 my，独立站用 mine；of 后面接 mine，不接 me。

core: 形容词性后接名词；名词性独立使用，二者不能并用
my/mine, your/yours, her/hers, our/ours, their/theirs；his、its 同形
名词性可作主语、宾语、表语
双重所有格：a friend of mine，不用 of me
all/both 放在物主代词之前：all my friends
review.trigger: 看到物主代词 → 看后面有没有名词 → 有名词用 my 型，没有用 mine 型

quickCheck.q: This book is ___ (I). 填什么？
a friend of me 错在哪里？
quickCheck.a: of 后须用名词性物主代词 mine。

quickCheck.q: all my friends 还是 my all friends？

drills.stem: Your design is original, but ___ is more practical.
drills.explain: 空格作主语且后面没有名词，须用名词性物主代词 hers。
drills.trap: her 是形容词性形式，后面缺名词；her's 在英语中不存在。

drills.stem: That umbrella is not ___; it belongs to the woman in blue. (I)
drills.hint: 表语位置，后面没有名词。
drills.explain: 系动词后作表语且无名词，用名词性物主代词 mine。

drills.stem: This notebook is my, but you can use it until Friday.
drills.answer: This notebook is mine, but you can use it until Friday.
accept: This notebook is mine, but you can use it until Friday.
drills.explain: 表语位置须用名词性物主代词 mine，my 只能作定语。

drills.stem: She is an old classmate of ___.
drills.explain: of + 名词性物主代词构成双重所有格，表示「我的一位老同学」。
drills.trap: of me 不是双重所有格结构，英语中不说 a classmate of me。

drills.stem: 我的自行车比他的新。
drills.answer: My bike is newer than his.
drills.explain: 比较对象是 his bike，用名词性物主代词 his；than him 会把比较对象变成人。

items.title: 反身代词的使用场景
items.brief: 同指、强调、固定搭配三种场合才用 -self

concept.summary: 反身代词只在三种场合出现：宾语与主语同指、作同位语强调、以及 enjoy oneself 一类固定搭配。除此之外，动作对象不是主语本人时一律用宾格。反身代词不能单独作主语，也不能代替主格出现在并列主语中。

sections.p: 第一、二人称由形容词性物主代词加 -self/-selves 构成，第三人称由宾格加 -self/-selves 构成。功能上分为宾语同指、同位语强调、固定搭配三类。
bullets: myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves, oneself
宾语同指：I cut myself while cooking.
同位语强调：The manager himself answered the phone.
固定搭配：by oneself, enjoy oneself, help oneself to

sections.p: 动作对象不是主语本人时，用宾格而不是反身代词。汉语的「给他」「帮她」在英语中要看是否与主语同指，这是最常见的判断点。
bullets: She taught her sister to swim.（教妹妹，不同指）
She taught herself to swim.（自学，同指）
He bought a gift for his mother.（不是 for himself）

sections.p: 反身代词没有主格形式，不能单独作主语，也不能与名词并列作主语。需要强调主语时，把它放在同位语位置。
bullets: × Myself will chair the meeting. → √ I myself will chair the meeting.
× He and myself are responsible. → √ He and I are responsible.
√ I made the cake myself.（同位语，可省略）

examples.en: She taught herself to play the guitar.
examples.zh: 她自学了弹吉他。
examples.note: teach 的宾语与主语同指，用反身代词。

examples.en: She taught her to play the guitar.
examples.zh: 她教她弹吉他。
examples.note: 宾语与主语同指时必须用 herself；用 her 会被理解为另一个人。

examples.en: The manager himself answered the phone.
examples.zh: 经理亲自接了电话。
examples.note: 反身代词作同位语，强调「亲自」。

examples.en: Myself will chair the meeting.
examples.zh: 我将主持会议。
examples.note: 反身代词没有主格形式，不能作主语，应为 I myself will chair the meeting.

examples.en: Please help yourself to some fruit.
examples.zh: 请随便吃些水果。
examples.note: help oneself to 是固定搭配。

examples.en: He devoted himself to medical research.
examples.zh: 他献身于医学研究。
examples.note: devote oneself to 是固定搭配，to 后接名词。

examples.en: We built the shed by ourselves.
examples.zh: 我们自己搭了那间棚屋。
examples.note: by oneself 表示「独自、靠自己」。

pitfalls.wrong: I bought a gift for me.
pitfalls.right: I bought a gift for myself.
pitfalls.why: 介词宾语与主语同指，必须用反身代词。

pitfalls.wrong: Please make you at home.
pitfalls.right: Please make yourself at home.
pitfalls.why: make oneself at home 是固定短语，反身代词不可换成宾格。

pitfalls.wrong: He and myself are responsible for the budget.
pitfalls.right: He and I are responsible for the budget.
pitfalls.why: 并列主语须用主格，反身代词不能占据主语位置。

contrast.withTitle: 相互代词 each other 与 one another
contrast.diff: 反身代词指动作回到主语自身，相互代词指两个或更多主体彼此之间。

concept.mnemonic: 同指、强调、固定搭配才用 -self；能作主语的只有主格。

core: 三种场合：宾语同指、同位语强调、固定搭配
宾语与主语不同指时用宾格：She taught her sister.
反身代词不能作主语：× Myself will do it.
固定搭配：by oneself, enjoy oneself, help oneself to, devote oneself to
强调用法可省略，省略后句子仍成立
review.trigger: 看到动词或介词的宾语与主语指同一人 → 用 -self；指不同人 → 用宾格

quickCheck.q: I hurt ___ while climbing. 填什么？
Myself will do it. 错在哪里？
quickCheck.a: 反身代词不能作主语，应为 I will do it myself。

quickCheck.q: enjoy oneself 中的 oneself 能换成 you 吗？

drills.stem: She cut ___ while chopping vegetables.
drills.explain: cut 的宾语与主语 she 同指，须用反身代词 herself。
drills.trap: her 是宾格，会表示「切到了另一个人」。

drills.stem: The children enjoyed ___ at the amusement park. (they)
drills.explain: enjoy oneself 是固定搭配，主语为复数，故用 themselves。

drills.stem: I hurt me while climbing the ladder.
drills.answer: I hurt myself while climbing the ladder.
accept: I hurt myself while climbing the ladder.
drills.explain: hurt 的宾语与主语同指，须用反身代词 myself；me 会被理解为另一个人。

drills.stem: In ___ , the plan is sound, but the timetable is unrealistic.
drills.explain: in itself 是固定短语，意为「本身、本质上」，用反身代词 itself 指代 the plan。
drills.trap: it 不能与介词构成 in itself 这一固定短语；its 是物主代词，不能作介词宾语。

drills.stem: 请随便吃些水果。
drills.answer: Please help yourself to some fruit.
drills.explain: help oneself to sth 是固定搭配，表示「随便取用」；fruit 作物质名词用单数。

items.title: 相互代词 each other 与 one another
items.brief: 两个用 each other，三个以上用 one another

concept.summary: each other 与 one another 都表示「互相」，只能作宾语，不能作主语。传统规则按数量分工：两者用 each other，三者及以上用 one another，考试按此判断；现代英语中两者常互换。所有格形式分别是 each other's 与 one another's，只加一个 's。

sections.p: 传统语法按参与者的数量选择形式，这是考试与教材的判定标准。现代英语中两者可互换，但在需要明确数量的题目里仍按传统规则作答。
bullets: 两者：The two sisters write to each other every week.
三者以上：The three colleagues help one another with difficult tasks.
one another 偶用于两者，但考试优先按传统分工判断

sections.p: 相互代词只能出现在动词或介词之后作宾语，不能作主语，也没有主格形式。所有格在词尾加 's，且 each other 本身不加 s。
bullets: √ They respect each other's opinions.
× Each other should be trusted.（不能作主语）
× each others' / × each others（无复数形式）
介词后：learn from each other, talk to one another

sections.p: 反身代词表示动作回到主语自身，相互代词表示主体之间的双向动作。同一个动词换用两者，句意完全不同。
bullets: They helped each other.（互相帮助）
They helped themselves.（自己动手，没靠别人）
They blamed themselves.（自责）/ They blamed each other.（互相指责）

examples.en: The two sisters write to each other every week.
examples.zh: 姐妹俩每周互相写信。
examples.note: 两者之间用 each other。

examples.en: The three colleagues often help one another with difficult tasks.
examples.zh: 三位同事常互相帮忙处理棘手任务。
examples.note: 三者以上用 one another。

examples.en: They respect each other's opinions.
examples.zh: 他们尊重彼此的意见。
examples.note: 所有格形式为 each other's，只在词尾加 's。

examples.en: They respect each others' opinions.
examples.zh: 他们尊重彼此的意见。
examples.note: each other 没有复数形式，所有格应为 each other's。

examples.en: Each other should be trusted.
examples.zh: 彼此之间应当互相信任。
examples.note: 相互代词不能作主语，应改为 They should trust each other.

examples.en: They helped themselves to more coffee.
examples.zh: 他们自己又添了些咖啡。
examples.note: 反身代词表「自己动手」，与相互代词意义不同。

pitfalls.wrong: The twin brothers help themselves with homework.
pitfalls.right: The twin brothers help each other with homework.
pitfalls.why: 两人互相帮助须用相互代词；themselves 表示各自帮自己。

pitfalls.wrong: They sent gifts to each others.
pitfalls.right: They sent gifts to each other.
pitfalls.why: each other 无复数形式，只有所有格才加 's。

pitfalls.wrong: Each other should respect our differences.
pitfalls.right: We should respect each other's differences.
pitfalls.why: 相互代词只能作宾语，主语位置须用主格代词。

contrast.diff: 反身代词的动作对象是主语自身；相互代词的动作在两个主体之间往返。

concept.mnemonic: 两个 each other，三个以上 one another；只作宾语，所有格加 's。

core: 两者 each other，三者以上 one another（考试按传统分工）
只能作宾语，不能作主语
所有格 each other's / one another's，只加一个 's
each other 无复数形式：× each others
与反身代词区分：helped each other（互相）/ helped themselves（自己）
review.trigger: 看到「互相」且能数出参与者数量 → 两个用 each other，三个以上用 one another，再确认它在宾语位置

quickCheck.q: 三名同事互相帮助用哪个？
each others' 错在哪里？
quickCheck.a: each other 无复数，所有格是 each other's。

quickCheck.q: Each other should be trusted. 错在哪里？

drills.stem: The two roommates always share ___ notes before exams.
drills.explain: 两人之间用 each other，所有格加 's 构成 each other's。
drills.trap: each others' 把 each other 当作可数名词先加 s 再加撇号，形式不存在。

drills.stem: The five members of the team trust ___ another completely.
drills.explain: 五名成员属三者以上，用 one another，空格填 one。

drills.stem: The two sisters often borrow each others' clothes.
drills.answer: The two sisters often borrow each other's clothes.
accept: The two sisters often borrow each other's clothes.
drills.explain: each other 无复数形式，所有格只在词尾加 's。

drills.stem: After the argument, they refused to speak to ___ for a week.
drills.explain: speak to 后作介词宾语，表「彼此」用 each other；两人之间用 each other。
drills.trap: themselves 表「他们自己」，与「互不理睬」的意思不符。

drills.stem: 这两个孩子互相帮助做作业。
drills.answer: The two children help each other with their homework.
drills.explain: 两个孩子之间用 each other，作 help 的宾语；with their homework 表示帮助的内容。

items.title: 指示代词的指代范围
items.brief: this/these 指近，that/those 指远并可替代

concept.summary: this/these 指向近处、当前或下文即将出现的内容，that/those 指向远处、过去或上文已出现的内容。除空间时间指示外，that/those 还承担替代功能，替代前面提到的名词以避免重复，单数用 that、复数用 those。替代时不能漏掉比较对象。

sections.p: this/these 与说话人的距离近，that/those 距离远。距离既可以是空间，也可以是时间或心理距离：正在说的事用 this，已说完的事用 that。
bullets: 空间：this book in my hand / that building across the river
时间：this week（本周）/ that summer（那个夏天）
心理：Now listen to this.（接下来要说的）/ That was a mistake.（已发生的事）

sections.p: that 常回指上文整件事，this 常引出下文要说的内容。介绍他人时固定用 This is...，即使对方不在手边。
bullets: He was late for the third time. That annoyed everyone.
What I need is this: a quiet room and two free hours.
This is my colleague, Mr. Zhao.（介绍）

sections.p: that/those 替代前面出现的名词，常用于比较结构，后面常带 of/in 短语。替代时单复数必须与被替代名词一致，可数不可数都可以用 that/those。
bullets: The climate here is milder than that of the north.（that = the climate）
The prices are lower than those in the city centre.（those = the prices）
× than Harbin（比较对象不对应）

examples.en: The weather in Kunming is milder than that in Harbin.
examples.zh: 昆明的天气比哈尔滨温和。
examples.note: that 替代单数的 the weather，避免重复。

examples.en: The weather in Kunming is milder than Harbin.
examples.zh: 昆明的天气比哈尔滨温和。
examples.note: 比较对象不对应，哈尔滨是城市不是天气，须用 that in Harbin。

examples.en: These shoes are too tight; those in the window look wider.
examples.zh: 这双鞋太紧了，橱窗里的那些看起来宽些。
examples.note: those 替代复数 the shoes。

examples.en: He was late for the third time. That annoyed everyone.
examples.zh: 他第三次迟到，那让所有人都恼火。
examples.note: that 回指上文整件事。

examples.en: This is my colleague, Mr. Zhao.
examples.zh: 这是我的同事赵先生。
examples.note: 介绍他人固定用 This is...

examples.en: The population of Shanghai is larger than those of Nanjing.
examples.zh: 上海的人口比南京多。
examples.note: population 是单数概念，替代应用 that of Nanjing。

pitfalls.wrong: The rules of chess are simpler than that of Go.
pitfalls.right: The rules of chess are simpler than those of Go.
pitfalls.why: 被替代的 rules 是复数，须用 those。

pitfalls.wrong: The output this year is higher than last year.
pitfalls.right: The output this year is higher than that of last year.
pitfalls.why: 比较对象须同类，that 替代 the output，否则变成产量与年份比较。

pitfalls.wrong: These kind of problems are common in rural areas.
pitfalls.right: This kind of problem is common in rural areas.
pitfalls.why: kind 是单数中心词，用 this 且谓语用单数。

contrast.diff: 指示代词靠距离选择 this/that；替代词看「同物、同类泛指还是同类特指」，that/those 只负责同类特指。

concept.mnemonic: 近的 this，远的 that；上文 that，下文 this；替代单数 that、复数 those。

core: this/these 近指，that/those 远指（空间、时间、心理）
that 回指上文，this 引出下文
介绍他人用 This is...
that/those 替代前文名词，单复数须一致
比较结构中不能省略替代词：than that of last year
review.trigger: 看到比较结构里名词重复 → 用 that/those 替代 → 检查单复数与后面的 of/in 短语

quickCheck.q: The weather here is better than ___ in the north. 填什么？
介绍同事时用 This is 还是 That is？
population 用 that 还是 those 替代？

drills.stem: The air quality in this district is much better than ___ in the industrial zone.
drills.explain: 替代前面单数的 the air quality，用 that，后接 in 短语限定范围。
drills.trap: it 指同一事物，此处是两地的空气质量对比，属同类不同物。

drills.stem: The novels of Lu Xun are more widely read than ___ of many contemporary writers.
drills.hint: 被替代的 novels 是复数。
drills.explain: novels 为复数，替代用 those，构成 those of many contemporary writers。

drills.stem: The number of visitors this year is twice those of last year.
drills.answer: The number of visitors this year is twice that of last year.
accept: The number of visitors this year is twice that of last year.
drills.explain: 被替代的 the number 是单数，应用 that of last year。

drills.stem: ___ is my sister, and the girl over there is her classmate.
drills.explain: 介绍他人时固定用 This is...，谓语用单数 is。
drills.trap: That 用于远指，但介绍句式固定为 This is...，与物理距离无关。

drills.stem: 这里的天气比北方暖和。
drills.answer: The weather here is warmer than that in the north.
drills.explain: 比较对象须同类，用 that 替代 the weather；the one 不能替代不可数名词。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: These books are more useful than those on the shelf.
drills.explain: those 替代前文的 books，后接 on the shelf 限定范围，比较对象因此对应。

items.title: some 与 any 的用法差异
items.brief: 肯定句用 some，否定疑问用 any，请求提供例外

concept.summary: some 与 any 的基本分工由句式决定：肯定句用 some，否定句与疑问句用 any。两种例外必须掌握：疑问句中表请求、提供或期待肯定回答时用 some；肯定句中表「任何一个」时用 any。两者都可修饰复数可数与不可数名词。

sections.p: 陈述事实的肯定句用 some，否定句与一般疑问句用 any。这一步只看句式，不看名词可数性。
bullets: I have some questions about the last point.
I don't have any questions about the last point.
Do you have any questions about the last point?
some/any 均可修饰复数可数与不可数：some books, some water

sections.p: 说话人期待对方同意、或正在提出请求与提供时，疑问句用 some。判断信号是「我希望答案是 yes」。
bullets: Would you like some coffee?（提供）
Could I have some water?（请求）
May I ask you some questions?（期待同意）
对比：Do you have any questions?（中性询问，答案未知）

sections.h: any 的肯定用法与 some 的数量义
sections.p: any 在肯定句中表示「任何一个」，强调不加区分的全称；some 与数词连用可表示「大约」。这两种用法都不能按基本分工推导。
bullets: Any student can join the club.
You may come at any time.
Some twenty people attended the lecture.（some = 大约）

examples.en: I need some help with this report.
examples.zh: 这份报告我需要一些帮助。
examples.note: 肯定句陈述事实，用 some。

examples.en: I don't need some help with this report.
examples.zh: 这份报告我不需要帮助。
examples.note: 否定句用 any，应为 don't need any help。

examples.en: Would you like some coffee?
examples.zh: 你想喝点咖啡吗？
examples.note: 提供饮品时用 some，期待对方接受。

examples.en: Do you have any idea what happened?
examples.zh: 你知道发生了什么吗？
examples.note: 中性疑问句用 any。

examples.en: Any child can learn to swim.
examples.zh: 任何孩子都能学会游泳。
examples.note: 肯定句中 any 表「任何一个」。

examples.en: He didn't say something about the plan.
examples.zh: 他没有说任何关于这个计划的事。
examples.note: 否定句须用 anything，something 只用于肯定语境。

examples.en: Some twenty people attended the lecture.
examples.zh: 大约二十人听了讲座。
examples.note: some 与数词连用表示「大约」。

pitfalls.wrong: I don't have some money with me.
pitfalls.right: I don't have any money with me.
pitfalls.why: 否定句的宾语位置须用 any，some 只用于肯定语境。

pitfalls.wrong: Would you like any tea?
pitfalls.right: Would you like some tea?
pitfalls.why: 提供饮品时期待肯定回答，须用 some。

pitfalls.wrong: I have any questions about the last point.
pitfalls.right: I have some questions about the last point.
pitfalls.why: 肯定句陈述存在，用 some；any 在肯定句只能表「任何一个」。

contrast.withTitle: 复合不定代词的修饰语后置
contrast.diff: some/any 的选择由句式与语气决定；something/anything 继承同一分工，但形容词修饰它们时必须后置。

concept.mnemonic: 肯定 some，否定疑问 any；请求提供用 some，肯定句里 any 表「任何」。

core: 肯定句 some，否定句与疑问句 any
请求、提供、期待 yes 的疑问句用 some
肯定句 any = 任何一个：Any student can join.
some + 数词 = 大约：some twenty people
some/any 都可修饰可数复数与不可数名词
review.trigger: 看到空格 → 先判句式（肯定/否定/疑问）→ 再判语气（请求提供还是中性询问）→ 选 some 或 any

quickCheck.q: Would you like ___ tea? 填什么？
quickCheck.a: some，提供饮品时期待肯定回答。

quickCheck.q: I don't have ___ money. 填什么？
Any student can join. 中 any 是什么意思？

drills.stem: Would you like ___ more soup? There is plenty left.
drills.explain: 主动提供食物并期待对方接受，疑问句用 some。
drills.trap: any 是一般疑问句的默认选择，但此处语气是提供，不是中性询问。

drills.stem: I'm afraid I don't have ___ time to spare this afternoon.
drills.explain: 否定句中修饰不可数名词 time 用 any。

drills.stem: I don't have some information about the schedule yet.
drills.answer: I don't have any information about the schedule yet.
accept: I don't have any information about the schedule yet.
drills.explain: 否定句须用 any；some 只用于肯定语境。

drills.stem: ___ student in the school can use the library until nine.
drills.explain: 肯定句中 any 表「任何一个」，与全称含义一致，后接单数名词。
drills.trap: Some 表「一些」，不能表达「任何一个学生都」的全称判断。

drills.stem: 你能给我一些关于这门课程的建议吗？
drills.answer: Could you give me some advice about the course?
drills.explain: 请求语境用 some；advice 不可数，不能加 s 或加 a。

items.title: 复合不定代词的修饰语后置
items.brief: 形容词修饰复合不定代词要后置，谓语用单数

concept.summary: something、anybody、nothing、everyone 等复合不定代词被形容词、不定式或 else 修饰时，修饰语一律后置，不能按汉语语序前置。它们作主语时谓语用单数。否定意义用 nothing/nobody 表达，不能与 not 叠加成双重否定。

sections.p: 复合不定代词由 some/any/no/every 与 -thing/-body/-one 组合而成，结构上是「代词 + 修饰语」，因此形容词、不定式、else 都放在后面。
bullets: something important / nothing new / anything else / somebody rich
× important something / × new nothing
不定式后置：I have something to tell you. / There is nothing to worry about.
else 的所有格：somebody else's coat

sections.p: 这类代词在语义上指多个，但语法形式是单数，作主语时谓语用单数；回指可用 they/their，这是现代英语的通行做法。
bullets: Everybody is here. / Nothing was said at the meeting.
Everyone has handed in the assignment.
Everybody should bring their own lunch.

sections.p: 英语一个句子只允许一个否定成分。用了 nobody/nothing/never，就不能再用 not；需要 not 时改用 anybody/anything。部分否定则把 not 放在句首位置。
bullets: √ Nobody knows the answer. / √ I don't know anybody here.
× I don't know nobody here.
部分否定：Not everybody agreed.（并非所有人都同意）

examples.en: I have something important to discuss with you.
examples.zh: 我有件重要的事要和你商量。
examples.note: 形容词 important 与不定式 to discuss 都后置修饰 something。

examples.en: I have important something to discuss with you.
examples.zh: 我有件重要的事要和你商量。
examples.note: 形容词修饰复合不定代词必须后置，应为 something important。

examples.en: Is there anything else you want to add?
examples.zh: 你还有什么想补充的吗？
examples.note: else 后置修饰 anything。

examples.en: Everybody in the class has finished the reading.
examples.zh: 班上每个人都读完了材料。
examples.note: 复合不定代词作主语，谓语用单数 has。

examples.en: Everybody in the class have finished the reading.
examples.zh: 班上每个人都读完了材料。
examples.note: 主语 everybody 视为单数，谓语须用 has。

examples.en: Nobody knows the answer.
examples.zh: 没人知道答案。
examples.note: nobody 本身是否定意义，谓语用肯定形式。

examples.en: I didn't say nothing at the meeting.
examples.zh: 我在会上什么也没说。
examples.note: 否定叠加构成双重否定，应改为 I didn't say anything 或 I said nothing。

pitfalls.wrong: There is new nothing in his report.
pitfalls.right: There is nothing new in his report.
pitfalls.why: 形容词修饰复合不定代词必须后置，new 不能放在 nothing 之前。

pitfalls.wrong: Everyone have handed in their essays.
pitfalls.right: Everyone has handed in their essays.
pitfalls.why: 复合不定代词作主语，谓语按单数处理。

pitfalls.wrong: I don't know nobody here.
pitfalls.right: I don't know anybody here.
pitfalls.why: 英语一个句子只允许一个否定词，not 与 nobody 不能同现。

contrast.withTitle: some 与 any 的用法差异
contrast.diff: some/any 的选择看句式与语气；复合不定代词除继承这一分工外，还有修饰语后置与谓语单数两条独立规则。

concept.mnemonic: 形容词往后放，else 也往后；everybody 当单数；not 与 nobody 不碰面。

core: 形容词、不定式、else 修饰复合不定代词时一律后置
复合不定代词作主语，谓语用单数
nobody/nothing 与 not 不能同现，避免双重否定
else 的所有格：somebody else's
部分否定用 not everybody，全否定用 nobody
review.trigger: 看到 something/anything/nothing/everybody → 形容词放后面；作主语按单数配谓语

quickCheck.q: 「重要的事情」怎么说？
Everyone ___ (have) finished. 填什么？
I don't know nobody. 错在哪里？
quickCheck.a: 双重否定，应改为 I don't know anybody。

drills.stem: The manager has ___ to say about the delay.
drills.explain: 形容词 important 修饰 something 时必须后置；肯定句用 something。
drills.trap: important something 按汉语语序前置定语；anything important 在肯定句中不合规则。

drills.stem: Is there ___ else you would like to know?
drills.hint: 一般疑问句用 any- 系列。
drills.explain: 一般疑问句用 anything，else 后置修饰它。

drills.stem: Nobody have complained about the new schedule so far.
drills.answer: Nobody has complained about the new schedule so far.
accept: Nobody has complained about the new schedule so far.
drills.explain: nobody 作主语视为单数，谓语须用 has。

drills.stem: Everybody who attends the workshop ___ a certificate at the end.
drills.explain: 主语 everybody 是单数概念，谓语用第三人称单数 receives。
drills.trap: 受汉语「大家」的复数含义影响而误选 receive。

drills.stem: 我有重要的事情要告诉你。
drills.answer: I have something important to tell you.
drills.explain: 形容词 important 与不定式 to tell you 都后置修饰 something。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Is there anything else you want to add?
drills.explain: anything 为主语，else 后置；you want to add 是省略关系代词的定语从句。

items.title: both/either/neither/all/none 的指代与谓语
items.brief: 先数范围是两者还是三者以上，再定谓语

concept.summary: both/either/neither 只用于两者，all/none 用于三者及以上（all 也可指不可数）。谓语看中心词：both/all 指可数复数时用复数，all 指不可数时用单数，either/neither 通常用单数，none 正式用单数、口语可用复数。范围判断是第一步。

sections.h: 范围：两者还是三者以上
sections.p: both 指两者都，either 指两者中任一，neither 指两者都不；all 指三者及以上全部，none 指三者及以上都不。用错范围是这一类题最主要的失分点。
bullets: Both of my parents are teachers.
Neither of the two answers is correct.
None of the five applicants has the required experience.
× None of the two brothers agreed.

sections.p: both/all 后接可数复数时谓语用复数，接不可数名词时用单数；either/neither 表单一选择，谓语用单数；none 的谓语正式用单数。
bullets: Both of the plans are practical.
All the information was accurate.（不可数 → 单数）
All the students were excited.（复数 → 复数）
Neither of them is ready.

sections.p: both/all 位于实义动词前、be 动词与助动词之后；none 可与 of 连用，no one 只指人且不与 of 连用。
bullets: They both agreed. / They have all left. / We are both ready.
None of the money was found.
No one knows the answer.（× No one of them knows）

examples.en: Both of my parents are teachers.
examples.zh: 我父母都是教师。
examples.note: both 指两者全体，谓语用复数。

examples.en: Both of my parents is a teacher.
examples.zh: 我父母都是教师。
examples.note: both 指两者全体，谓语须用复数 are。

examples.en: Neither of the two answers is correct.
examples.zh: 两个答案都不正确。
examples.note: neither 指两者都不，谓语用单数。

examples.en: Neither of the three answers is correct.
examples.zh: 三个答案都不正确。
examples.note: 三者以上全部否定用 none，neither 只用于两者。

examples.en: None of the five applicants has the required experience.
examples.zh: 五名申请者都没有所要求的经验。
examples.note: none 指三者以上全不，正式谓语用单数。

examples.en: All the information was accurate.
examples.zh: 所有信息都准确。
examples.note: all 后接不可数名词，谓语用单数。

examples.en: Either of the plans work well.
examples.zh: 两个方案中任一个都可行。
examples.note: either 表单数概念，谓语须用 works。

pitfalls.wrong: None of the two brothers agreed.
pitfalls.right: Neither of the two brothers agreed.
pitfalls.why: 两者全部否定用 neither，none 用于三者及以上。

pitfalls.wrong: All of the water were polluted.
pitfalls.right: All of the water was polluted.
pitfalls.why: water 不可数，all of 的中心词为不可数名词时谓语用单数。

pitfalls.wrong: Neither of them are ready.
pitfalls.right: Neither of them is ready.
pitfalls.why: neither 表「两者都不」，是单数概念，正式谓语用单数。

contrast.withTitle: 复合不定代词的修饰语后置
contrast.diff: both/all 一组考范围与主谓一致；复合不定代词考修饰语位置与单数谓语，判定依据不同。

concept.mnemonic: 两个 both/either/neither，三个以上 all/none；neither 单数，all 看名词。

core: both/either/neither 用于两者；all/none 用于三者以上
both/all + 可数复数 → 谓语复数；all + 不可数 → 谓语单数
either/neither 视为单数，谓语用单数
none 正式用单数，口语可用复数
none of 可接人或物；no one 只指人，不接 of
review.trigger: 看到 both/either/neither/all/none → 先数范围，再看后面名词可数性 → 最后定谓语

quickCheck.q: 两者都不去用 neither 还是 none？
All of the water ___ (be) polluted. 填什么？
Neither of them are ready. 错在哪里？
quickCheck.a: neither 表单数，正式谓语用 is。

drills.stem: ___ of the two candidates has enough experience for the post.
drills.explain: the two 限定为两者，且谓语 has 为单数，只有 neither 同时满足范围与数。
drills.trap: None 用于三者及以上，与 the two 冲突。

drills.stem: ___ of the ten students failed the test; all of them passed.
drills.explain: 十人属三者以上且表示全部否定，用 none；后半句 all passed 也印证了这一点。

drills.stem: Neither of the twins are willing to take responsibility.
drills.answer: Neither of the twins is willing to take responsibility.
accept: Neither of the twins is willing to take responsibility.
drills.explain: neither 表两者都不，是单数概念，正式谓语用 is。

drills.stem: All of the furniture in the room ___ been replaced.
drills.explain: furniture 不可数，all of 的中心词为不可数名词，谓语用单数 has。
drills.trap: 受 all 的「全部」含义影响误用复数 have。

drills.stem: 他们两个都不想去。
drills.answer: Neither of them wants to go.
drills.explain: 两者全部否定用 neither，谓语用单数 wants；both...not 是部分否定，语义变成「不是两个都想去」。

items.title: one/ones/it/that 的替代区别
items.brief: 同物用 it，同类泛指用 one，同类特指用 that

concept.summary: 替代词的选择取决于「同物还是同类」：it 指前面提到的同一个事物；one/ones 指同类中不特定的一个，可带限定词与形容词；that/those 指同类中的特定对象，多用于比较结构并后接 of/in 短语。不可数名词不能用 one 替代，要用 that。

sections.p: 先问「是不是同一个」：同一个用 it；不是同一个但属同类，再看是泛指还是特指：泛指用 one/ones，特指用 that/those。
bullets: 同物：I lost my keys. Have you seen them?
同类泛指：I lost my pen, so I bought a new one.
同类特指：The engine of this car is more powerful than that of the old model.

sections.p: one 前可加 a/the/this/that/which 与形容词，ones 前必须有修饰语。所有格用 one's，不用 ones'。
bullets: a new one / the red one / this one / which one
the ones in the box / the red ones
× a ones / × the ones（无修饰语时不单独使用）

sections.h: 不可数名词只能用 that
sections.p: 不可数名词没有 one 的替代形式，比较结构中一律用 that。这是语法填空与改错的高频点。
bullets: The coffee here is stronger than that in the shop next door.
× than the one in the shop next door
复数用 those：The streets here are narrower than those in the new district.

examples.en: I lost my umbrella, so I bought a new one.
examples.zh: 我把伞丢了，所以买了一把新的。
examples.note: one 替代同类中不特定的一把伞。

examples.en: I lost my umbrella, so I bought a new it.
examples.zh: 我把伞丢了，所以买了一把新的。
examples.note: it 指同一把伞，与「买新的」矛盾，应用 one。

examples.en: The engine of this car is more powerful than that of the old model.
examples.zh: 这辆车的发动机比旧款的更强劲。
examples.note: that 替代 the engine，属同类特指。

examples.en: I don't like these apples; give me the red ones.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢这些苹果，给我那些红的。
examples.note: ones 替代复数 apples，前有形容词修饰。

examples.en: The coffee here is stronger than the one in the shop next door.
examples.zh: 这里的咖啡比隔壁店里的浓。
examples.note: coffee 不可数，不能用 one 替代，应用 that。

examples.en: I can't find my keys. Have you seen them?
examples.zh: 我找不到钥匙了，你看见了吗？
examples.note: them 指同一串钥匙，属同物替代。

pitfalls.wrong: This pen doesn't work. Please give me another it.
pitfalls.right: This pen doesn't work. Please give me another one.
pitfalls.why: another 后接同类泛指，须用 one；it 指同一支笔。

pitfalls.wrong: My bike is faster than one you bought.
pitfalls.right: My bike is faster than the one you bought.
pitfalls.why: 有定语从句限定，属同类特指，须用 the one。

pitfalls.wrong: The population of China is larger than one of India.
pitfalls.right: The population of China is larger than that of India.
pitfalls.why: population 在此为不可数概念，同类特指用 that。

contrast.diff: this/that 靠距离与上下文选择；one/it/that 靠「同物、同类泛指、同类特指」选择，判定依据是所指关系。

concept.mnemonic: 同一个用 it，同类泛指 one，同类特指 that；不可数只认 that。

core: it = 同一个事物；one/ones = 同类中不特定的一个
that/those = 同类中的特定对象，常用于比较结构
one 前可加 a/the/this/which 与形容词；ones 前必须有修饰语
不可数名词不能用 one，须用 that
another one / the one you bought 均为固定搭配
review.trigger: 看到需要替代前面名词 → 先判同物还是同类 → 同类再判泛指（one）还是特指（that/those）

quickCheck.q: I lost my pen, so I bought a new ___. 填什么？
coffee 能用 one 替代吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，不可数名词用 that。

quickCheck.q: the one you bought 为什么加 the？
quickCheck.a: 有定语从句限定，属同类特指。

drills.stem: This camera is out of order; could you show me another ___?
drills.explain: another 后接同类泛指的单数替代词 one，camera 是可数名词。
drills.trap: it 指同一台相机，与「另一台」的意思矛盾。

drills.stem: The streets in the old town are narrower than ___ in the new district.
drills.hint: 被替代的 streets 是复数。
drills.explain: streets 为复数，同类特指用 those，后接 in the new district。

drills.stem: The service in this restaurant is better than the one in the hotel across the street.
drills.answer: The service in this restaurant is better than that in the hotel across the street.
accept: The service in this restaurant is better than that in the hotel across the street.
drills.explain: service 不可数，不能用 the one 替代，须用 that。

drills.stem: I've read both articles, but I prefer ___ about climate change.
drills.explain: 两篇文章中特指某一篇，用 the one，并带后置定语 about climate change。
drills.trap: ones 是复数形式，与「两篇中选一篇」的单数所指不符。

drills.stem: 这台电脑比我在商店里看到的那台便宜。
drills.answer: This computer is cheaper than the one I saw in the shop.
drills.explain: 比较对象是同类特指的那台电脑，用 the one，后接定语从句 I saw in the shop；it 指同一台，that 不能直接跟定语从句。

items.title: 疑问代词与关系代词的界限
items.brief: 前面有先行词是关系代词，无疑问意义是连接词

concept.summary: who/whom/whose/which 有三种句法身份：在疑问句中作疑问代词，在定语从句中作关系代词，在名词性从句中作连接代词。判定看两点：前面有没有先行名词，以及从句是否表达疑问。关系代词必须在从句中充当成分，因此从句内不能再出现重复的代词。

sections.p: 同一个词形式相同，功能不同：疑问代词构成特殊疑问句；关系代词引导定语从句，前面必有先行词；连接代词引导主语、宾语、表语从句，整句没有疑问语气。
bullets: 疑问：Who broke the window?
关系：The boy who broke the window has apologized.
连接：I don't know who broke the window.

sections.p: 关系代词中 that 不能用于疑问句；what 不能引导定语从句，因为 what 本身已含先行词。which 在定语从句中指物，在疑问句与名词性从句中可指物或表选择范围。
bullets: × the book what I bought → √ the book that/which I bought
√ What he said surprised us.（what = the thing that）
√ Which of the two do you prefer?

sections.p: 关系代词在从句中充当主语或宾语，从句内不能再出现对应的代词。这是改错题最典型的设置。介词提到关系代词前时，用 whom 指人、which 指物。
bullets: × The girl who she won the prize is my sister.
√ The girl who won the prize is my sister.
√ The student to whom you spoke is my roommate.

examples.en: Who is responsible for the arrangements?
examples.zh: 谁负责这些安排？
examples.note: 疑问代词引导特殊疑问句，构成独立问句。

examples.en: The teacher who is responsible for the arrangements is on leave.
examples.zh: 负责这些安排的那位老师在休假。
examples.note: 关系代词 who 引导定语从句，先行词是 the teacher。

examples.en: I don't know who is responsible for the arrangements.
examples.zh: 我不知道谁负责这些安排。
examples.note: 连接代词引导宾语从句，整句没有疑问语气。

examples.en: The man who he called yesterday is my uncle.
examples.zh: 他昨天打电话的那个人是我叔叔。
examples.note: 关系代词 who 已充当 called 的宾语，从句内不能再出现 he。

examples.en: This is the book what I told you about.
examples.zh: 这就是我跟你说过的那本书。
examples.note: what 不能引导定语从句，应改为 that 或 which。

examples.en: What surprised me was his calm reaction.
examples.zh: 让我吃惊的是他冷静的反应。
examples.note: what 引导主语从句，相当于 the thing that。

examples.en: The student to whom you spoke is my roommate.
examples.zh: 和你说话的那个学生是我的室友。
examples.note: 介词 to 提到关系代词前，指人用 whom。

pitfalls.wrong: The girl who she won the prize is my sister.
pitfalls.right: The girl who won the prize is my sister.
pitfalls.why: 关系代词 who 已在从句中作主语，再加 she 会造成成分重复。

pitfalls.wrong: This is the reason what he gave.
pitfalls.right: This is the reason that he gave.
pitfalls.why: what 本身包含先行词，不能跟在名词后引导定语从句。

pitfalls.wrong: Who did you give the letter?
pitfalls.right: Who did you give the letter to?
pitfalls.why: give sth to sb 中的介词不能省略，疑问代词作介词宾语时介词须保留或前置。

contrast.withTitle: 代词指代的一致与明确性
contrast.diff: 本知识点解决「用哪一种代词引导从句」；指代一致性解决「代词与先行词在数、性、人称上是否匹配」。

concept.mnemonic: 前面有名词用关系代词，没有先行词用 what；从句里不能再塞一个代词。

core: 疑问代词构成疑问句；关系代词引导定语从句，前有先行词
连接代词引导名词性从句，无先行词，无疑问语气
what 不能引导定语从句，that 不能用于疑问句
关系代词已在从句中充当成分，不能再出现重复代词
介词 + whom/which 是书面语形式：to whom, of which
review.trigger: 看到 who/which/what → 先看前面有没有先行名词 → 有则关系代词，无则疑问或连接代词

quickCheck.q: This is the book ___ I bought. 填 what 可以吗？
quickCheck.a: 不可以，what 不能引导定语从句，用 that 或 which。

quickCheck.q: The girl who she won... 错在哪里？
quickCheck.a: who 已作主语，she 多余。

quickCheck.q: I don't know who he is. 中 who 是什么词？
quickCheck.a: 连接代词，引导宾语从句。

drills.stem: The engineer ___ designed the bridge received an award.
drills.explain: 定语从句缺主语，先行词 the engineer 指人，用主格关系代词 who。
drills.trap: whom 只在从句中作宾语；whose 表所属，后面必须接名词。

drills.stem: This is the novel ___ everyone is talking about.
drills.hint: 先行词是物，关系代词作 about 的宾语。
drills.explain: 先行词 the novel 指物，关系代词用 that 或 which 均可；what 不能跟在名词后。

drills.stem: The professor who we met at the conference he is from Beijing.
drills.answer: The professor who we met at the conference is from Beijing.
accept: The professor who we met at the conference is from Beijing.
drills.explain: 关系代词 who 已作 met 的宾语，从句内不能再出现 he，否则主句主语重复。

drills.stem: ___ made the decision has not been revealed.
drills.explain: 主语从句缺主语且指人，用 who 引导，整句没有疑问语气。
drills.trap: Whom 只能作宾语；Which 指物或表选择，与「谁做的决定」不符。

drills.stem: 我不知道他为什么改变了主意。
drills.answer: I don't know why he changed his mind.
drills.explain: 宾语从句用陈述语序，why 引导后接 he changed，不能倒装成 did he change。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The man who called you is my uncle.
drills.explain: 关系代词 who 在定语从句中作主语，后接谓语 called；主句谓语是 is。

items.title: 代词指代的一致与明确性
items.brief: 代词须与先行词数、性、人称一致且指向唯一

concept.summary: 代词的使用有两条硬约束：与先行词在数、性、人称上保持一致；全句只有一个可解释的先行词。集合名词看强调整体还是成员，everyone/each 按单数处理，one 不能与 you 混用。指向不明时应重复名词或改写句子。

sections.p: 先找先行词，再定代词的数与 Person。并列先行词用复数代词；each/every/either/neither 按单数；集合名词视语义选择单数或复数。
bullets: Each of the winners received his or her certificate.
The committee has reached its decision.（整体 → 单数 its）
The committee are divided in their opinions.（成员 → 复数 their，英式用法）
one 与 one 呼应，不能中途换成 you

sections.p: 句中出现两个同性别的可能先行词时，代词会产生歧义。解决办法是重复名词、调整语序或改写从句。
bullets: 歧义：When Mary met Anna, she was nervous.
改写：When Mary met Anna, Mary was nervous.
改写：Mary was nervous when she met Anna.

sections.p: 英语名词本身不分性别，代词按实际性别选择；动物、婴儿常用 it；国家、船只的 she 属文学用法。避免 his/her 反复堆叠，可用复数改写整句。
bullets: The baby dropped its toy.
Every student must bring his or her own calculator.（正式）
All students must bring their own calculators.（改为复数，更简洁）

examples.en: If a student wants to improve, he or she must practise daily.
examples.zh: 学生若想进步，就必须每天练习。
examples.note: a student 为单数，代词用 he or she 保持一致。

examples.en: If a student wants to improve, you must practise daily.
examples.zh: 学生若想进步，就必须每天练习。
examples.note: 先行词是 a student，人称代词不能用 you，须保持第三人称。

examples.en: Mary and Anna are close friends, and she often helps her with maths.
examples.zh: 玛丽和安娜是好朋友，她常帮她学数学。
examples.note: she 与 her 均可指玛丽或安娜，指代不明，应重复名词。

examples.en: The committee has reached its decision.
examples.zh: 委员会已经作出决定。
examples.note: 委员会作为整体，代词用单数 its。

examples.en: The committee are divided in their opinions.
examples.zh: 委员会成员意见分歧。
examples.note: 强调成员分歧，英式用法用复数 are 与 their。

examples.en: Each of the winners received a certificate and a cash prize.
examples.zh: 每位获奖者都得到一张证书和一笔奖金。
examples.note: each 作主语视为单数，句子以名词重复替代代词，不存在失配。

examples.en: Every applicant must submit his or her form by Friday.
examples.zh: 每位申请者必须在周五前提交表格。
examples.note: every + 单数名词，代词用 he or she。

pitfalls.wrong: If one wants to succeed, you must work hard.
pitfalls.right: If one wants to succeed, one must work hard.
pitfalls.why: one 与 you 人称不一致，同一句中的泛指代词须保持同一人称。

pitfalls.wrong: The company has changed their logo twice this year.
pitfalls.right: The company has changed its logo twice this year.
pitfalls.why: 单数机构作整体时，正式书面语用 its；their 会造成数不一致。

pitfalls.wrong: When the dog saw the cat, it ran away.
pitfalls.right: When the dog saw the cat, the dog ran away.
pitfalls.why: it 可指狗也可指猫，指向不唯一，须重复名词消除歧义。

contrast.withTitle: 人称代词主格与宾格的选用
contrast.diff: 本知识点管「代词与先行词是否匹配、指向是否唯一」；主格宾格管「同一个代词在句中用哪种形式」。

concept.mnemonic: 先找先行词，再查数、性、人称；两个可能就重复名词。

core: 代词与先行词在数、性、人称上必须一致
each/every/either/neither 按单数处理
集合名词强调整体用单数 its，强调成员用复数 their
one 与 one 呼应，不能中途换成 you
出现两个可能先行词时，重复名词或改写句子
review.trigger: 看到代词 → 先锁定唯一的先行词 → 再核对数、性、人称 → 有歧义就重复名词

quickCheck.q: If one wants to succeed, ___ must work hard. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: one，与前面的 one 保持一致。

quickCheck.q: The committee has reached ___ decision. 填什么？
When Mary met Anna, she was nervous. 有什么问题？
quickCheck.a: she 指代不明，应重复 Mary 或 Anna。

drills.stem: The company has revised ___ safety policy twice this year.
drills.explain: company 是单数机构，强调整体，正式书面语用物主代词 its。
drills.trap: their 在口语中常见，但与单数先行词 the company 在数上不一致。

drills.stem: Neither of the twins has finished ___ homework. (he)
drills.explain: neither 表单数概念，代词用单数 his，与 homework 搭配。

drills.stem: If one wants to learn a language well, you must practise every day.
drills.answer: If one wants to learn a language well, one must practise every day.
accept: If one wants to learn a language well, one must practise every day.
drills.explain: one 与 you 人称不一致，同一句中的泛指代词须统一为 one。

drills.stem: The committee ___ reached its decision, and the members have left the room.
drills.explain: 后半句 its 表明委员会被视为整体，谓语用单数 has。
drills.trap: have 会把委员会当作成员集合，与 its 的单数指代冲突。

drills.stem: 每个学生都必须交自己的作业。
drills.answer: Every student must hand in his or her own homework.
drills.explain: every + 单数名词，代词用 his or her（现代用法也可用 their）；you 与 its 都破坏了人称一致。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Each of the players has his own locker.
drills.explain: each of + 复数名词作主语视为单数，谓语用 has，代词用 his。
